name: org.openrewrite.golang.AddImport
description: Add an `import` statement to a Go compilation unit. No-op if the import is already present in a compatible form.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.
options: [{"name":"packagePath","type":"String","displayName":"Package path","description":"The import path to add.","example":"fmt","required":true},{"name":"onlyIfReferenced","type":"Boolean","displayName":"Only if referenced","description":"When true, add the import only if some identifier in the file already references the package via type attribution.","value":false}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.ChangeMethodName
description: Rename method invocations matching a method pattern.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.
options: [{"name":"methodPattern","type":"String","displayName":"Method pattern","description":"A method pattern to match method invocations.","example":"fmt.Println(..)","required":true},{"name":"newMethodName","type":"String","displayName":"New method name","description":"The new name for the method.","example":"Printf","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.ChangeType
description: Change a Go type reference from one fully qualified name to another.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.
options: [{"name":"oldFullyQualifiedTypeName","type":"String","displayName":"Old fully qualified type name","description":"The fully qualified Go type name to replace.","example":"github.com/old/pkg.MyType","required":true},{"name":"newFullyQualifiedTypeName","type":"String","displayName":"New fully qualified type name","description":"The fully qualified Go type name to use instead.","example":"github.com/new/pkg.MyType","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.OrderImports
description: Sort `import` lines into stdlib / third-party / local groups. Within each group, entries are alphabetized; non-empty groups are separated by a blank line. Mirrors `goimports -w`. Local detection uses the sibling go.mod's module path.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.RemoveImport
description: Remove an `import` statement from a Go compilation unit. Matches by import path; any form (regular, aliased, dot, blank) is removed.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.
options: [{"name":"packagePath","type":"String","displayName":"Package path","description":"The import path to remove.","example":"fmt","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.RemoveUnusedImports
description: Remove imports for packages that are not referenced by any identifier in the file. Blank (`_`) imports are preserved.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.RenamePackage
description: Rename a Go package across a project — rewrites the `package` declaration in files that own the package, and rewrites import paths in every file that references it.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.
options: [{"name":"oldPackagePath","type":"String","displayName":"Old package path","description":"The fully qualified package path to rename.","example":"github.com/old/foo","required":true},{"name":"newPackagePath","type":"String","displayName":"New package path","description":"The fully qualified package path to use instead.","example":"github.com/new/foo","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AddExportedFuncComment
description: Add a stub doc comment to exported functions and methods that lack one.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AllBranchesIdentical
description: Replace an if/else chain where every branch has the same body with just the body, since the conditions have no effect on the outcome.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AllocateMapOutsideLoop
description: Hoist `make(map[...]...)` calls out of for/range loops and clear the map each iteration.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AllocateOutsideLoop
description: Find `new()` calls inside for/range loops. Repeated heap allocations in loops add GC pressure; consider reusing the object.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditBindAllInterfaces
description: Find network listeners bound to all interfaces (e.g. `:8080`, `0.0.0.0`, `[::]`). This exposes the service beyond loopback and may be unintended; prefer an explicit host such as `127.0.0.1` (gosec G102).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditChannelClose
description: Find calls to the built-in `close()` function. Channels should only be closed by the sender, and double-closing causes a panic.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditContextBackground
description: Find calls to `context.Background()`. Consider using a context passed from the caller instead.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditErrorStringFormat
description: Find `errors.New` and `fmt.Errorf` messages that are capitalized or end with punctuation. Error strings are often embedded in a larger message, so they should not be capitalized or end with punctuation (staticcheck ST1005).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditExecCommand
description: Find calls to `exec.Command()`. If arguments come from user input, this is a potential command injection vulnerability.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditGoroutineClosure
description: Find `go func() { ... }()` patterns. Goroutines with closures can inadvertently capture loop variables.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditHttpRedirect
description: Find calls to `http.Redirect`. Review redirect targets to ensure they are validated and status codes are appropriate.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditJsonNumber
description: Find usage of `json.Number`. json.Number should be used carefully as it can lead to unexpected behavior when converting between numeric types.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditJsonRawMessage
description: Find usage of `json.RawMessage`. RawMessage defers JSON parsing and should be reviewed to ensure deferred parsing is handled correctly.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditMultipleErrorWraps
displayName: Replace extra %w verbs with %v in fmt.Errorf
description: Replace all but the first `%w` with `%v` in `fmt.Errorf` format strings. Multiple error wrapping is invalid in Go < 1.20 and rare in later versions.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditMustFunction
description: Find calls to functions named `Must*` or `must*`, which typically panic on error.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditRecover
description: Find calls to the built-in `recover()` function, which catches panics and signals unusual control flow.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditTestFatal
description: Find `t.Fatal()` and `t.Fatalf()` calls. These abort the test immediately and panic when called from a goroutine other than the test function's goroutine.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditTestMain
description: Find `func TestMain(m *testing.M)` declarations. TestMain overrides the default test execution for the entire package.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditYamlUnmarshal
description: Find calls to `yaml.Unmarshal()`. YAML parsing should validate input carefully to avoid unexpected behavior from untrusted data.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidChannelLenCheck
description: Find comparisons on channel length such as `len(ch) == 0`. These are almost always racy because the length can change between the check and the next operation.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidContextWithValue
description: Find calls to `context.WithValue()`. Context values are an anti-pattern for passing dependencies; prefer explicit function parameters.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidDeferInLoop
description: Wrap loop bodies containing `defer` in an immediately-invoked function literal so deferred calls run per iteration.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidDotImport
description: Remove the dot alias from `import . "pkg"`, converting to a normal import and re-qualifying references (e.g. `Println` to `fmt.Println`).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidEmptyInterfaceParam
description: Replace `interface{}` parameter types with `any` (Go 1.18+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidFmtInLoop
description: Find `fmt.Sprintf`, `fmt.Sprint`, or `fmt.Fprintf` calls inside for/range loops. These allocate on every call; prefer direct string operations or strconv.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidFormatStringVariable
description: Find calls like `fmt.Sprintf(variable)` where the format string is not a literal. This is a potential format string vulnerability.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidGlobalVariable
description: Find package-level `var` declarations. Mutable global state makes code harder to test and reason about.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidHardcodedCredentials
description: Replace hardcoded credential string literals with `os.Getenv("VAR_NAME")` calls.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidInitFunction
description: Find `func init()` declarations. Init functions make testing harder and have implicit ordering dependencies.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidLockInLoop
description: Find `Lock()` or `RLock()` calls inside for/range loops. Acquiring locks in tight loops can cause contention; consider locking once outside the loop.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidLogFatal
description: Replace `log.Fatal`, `log.Fatalf`, and `log.Fatalln` with their non-exiting equivalents (`log.Println`, `log.Printf`, `log.Println`).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidNestedGoroutine
description: Find goroutines launched inside other goroutines. Nested goroutines create hard-to-track concurrency.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidOsExit
description: Remove `os.Exit(0)` calls and flag non-zero `os.Exit(n)` which bypass deferred functions and cleanup.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidPanic
description: Find calls to the built-in `panic()` function, which crashes the program.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidReflection
description: Find `reflect.TypeOf()` and `reflect.ValueOf()` calls. Reflection is slow and should be avoided in performance-sensitive code.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidSqlStringConcat
description: Find string concatenation where the left operand contains SQL keywords. Use parameterized queries to avoid SQL injection.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidTimeSleep
description: Find calls to `time.Sleep()`. In production code, sleeping is often a code smell — consider using tickers, timers, or context-based synchronization.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidUnsafePackage
description: Find any usage of the `unsafe` package. The unsafe package bypasses Go's type safety guarantees and should be avoided unless absolutely necessary.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CheckCloseError
description: Replace bare `f.Close()` with `_ = f.Close()` to explicitly mark the discarded error.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CheckContextError
description: Find `ctx.Err()` calls. The context error should be inspected to distinguish between cancellation and deadline exceeded.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CheckTemplateExecuteError
description: Wrap bare calls to `Execute` and `ExecuteTemplate` on templates in an if-init error check so the returned error is not silently ignored.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CompileRegexOutsideLoop
description: Find `regexp.Compile()` or `regexp.MustCompile()` calls inside for/range loops. Compile the regex once outside the loop for better performance.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CreateChannelOutsideLoop
description: Find `make(chan ...)` calls inside for/range loops. Channel creation in loops suggests the channel should be created once before the loop.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.EnsureFileClosed
description: Find calls to `os.Open`, `os.Create`, and `os.OpenFile`. Ensure the returned file is closed to avoid resource leaks.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.EnsureSqlConnectionClosed
description: Find calls to `sql.Open`. Database connections should be managed carefully and closed when no longer needed.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.FindDeprecatedAtomicFunctions
description: Find deprecated `sync/atomic` free-function calls (e.g. `atomic.AddInt32`) that should be migrated to the type-safe atomic types introduced in Go 1.19 (e.g. `atomic.Int32`).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.FindEmptyFmtSprintf
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("")` calls with an empty format string and no args with `""`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.FindMapRangeClear
description: Replace `for k := range m { delete(m, k) }` with `clear(m)` (Go 1.21+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleCheckedError
description: Replace `if err != nil { }` with `if err != nil { return err }` so the error is propagated.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleDeferredCloseError
description: Wrap `defer x.Close()` in a closure to explicitly handle the error: `defer func() { _ = x.Close() }()`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleErrorReturn
description: Replace discarded `_` error return values with `err` to capture the error.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleSwallowedError
description: Replace `if err != nil { return }` with `if err != nil { return err }` so the error is propagated.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.KeepFunctionsShort
description: Find functions with more than 20 statements. Long functions are harder to understand and maintain.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.KeepInterfacesSmall
description: Find interfaces with more than 5 methods. Large interfaces violate the Interface Segregation Principle.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.LimitFunctionParameters
description: Find functions with more than 5 parameters. Consider grouping parameters into a struct.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.LimitGoroutinesInLoop
description: Find `go` statements inside for/range loops. Unbounded goroutine creation can cause resource exhaustion; consider using a worker pool.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.LimitReturnValues
description: Find functions with more than 3 return values. Consider returning a struct instead.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.MergeCollapsibleIf
description: Merge nested `if` statements into a single `if` with `&&` when neither has an else clause and the outer body contains only the inner `if`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.MergeIdenticalBranches
description: Merge consecutive if/else-if branches that have identical bodies by combining their conditions with `||`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreallocateSlice
description: Find `append()` calls inside for/range loops where the slice could be preallocated.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesBufferString
description: Replace `string(buf.Bytes())` with `buf.String()` for better performance and readability.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesContains
description: Replace `bytes.Index(b, sub) != -1` and similar patterns with `bytes.Contains(b, sub)`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesContainsAny
description: Replace `bytes.IndexAny(b, chars) != -1` with `bytes.ContainsAny(b, chars)` and `bytes.IndexAny(b, chars) == -1` with `!bytes.ContainsAny(b, chars)`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesContainsRune
description: Replace `bytes.IndexRune(b, r) != -1` with `bytes.ContainsRune(b, r)` and `bytes.IndexRune(b, r) == -1` with `!bytes.ContainsRune(b, r)`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesEqual
description: Replace `bytes.Compare(a, b) == 0` with `bytes.Equal(a, b)` and `bytes.Compare(a, b) != 0` with `!bytes.Equal(a, b)`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesHasPrefix
description: Replace `bytes.Index(b, prefix) == 0` with `bytes.HasPrefix(b, prefix)` and `bytes.Index(b, prefix) != 0` with `!bytes.HasPrefix(b, prefix)`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferCopyString
description: Replace `copy(dst, []byte(src))` with `copy(dst, src)` since copy accepts a string source.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferEmptyStringCheck
description: Replace `len(s) == 0` with `s == ""` and `len(s) != 0` with `s != ""`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorfWrapVerb
displayName: Prefer %w over %s in fmt.Errorf for error wrapping
description: Replace `%s` with `%w` in `fmt.Errorf` format strings when the corresponding argument is an error, to preserve the error chain.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsContext
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for context error comparison
description: Replace `err == context.Canceled` and `err == context.DeadlineExceeded` with `errors.Is` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsEOF
description: Replace `err == io.EOF` with `errors.Is(err, io.EOF)` and `err != io.EOF` with `!errors.Is(err, io.EOF)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsForFieldAccess
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for package-qualified sentinel comparison
description: Replace `err == sentinel` with `errors.Is(err, sentinel)` where the sentinel is a package-qualified value (e.g., `sql.ErrNoRows`). Use `errors.Is` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsForOsCheck
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for os existence checks
description: Replace deprecated `os.IsNotExist(err)` with `errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)` and `os.IsExist(err)` with `errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist)` (Go 1.16+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsForPermission
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for os permission checks
description: Replace deprecated `os.IsPermission(err)` with `errors.Is(err, fs.ErrPermission)` (Go 1.16+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsHttpServerClosed
description: Replace `err == http.ErrServerClosed` with `errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed)` and `err != http.ErrServerClosed` with `!errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsNetClosed
description: Replace `err == net.ErrClosed` with `errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed)` and `err != net.ErrClosed` with `!errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsOsInvalid
description: Replace `err == os.ErrInvalid` with `errors.Is(err, os.ErrInvalid)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsOverEquality
displayName: Prefer errors.Is over == for error comparison
description: Replace `err == ErrFoo` with `errors.Is(err, ErrFoo)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsSqlNoRows
description: Replace `err == sql.ErrNoRows` with `errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows)` and `err != sql.ErrNoRows` with `!errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferFilepathClean
description: Replace `filepath.Join(filepath.Clean(p))` with `filepath.Clean(p)` since Join with a single already-cleaned argument is redundant.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferHexEncoding
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%x", data)` with `hex.EncodeToString(data)` for clearer intent and better performance.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoDiscard
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.Discard` with `io.Discard` (Go 1.16+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoNopCloser
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.NopCloser(r)` with `io.NopCloser(r)` (Go 1.16+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoReadAll
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.ReadAll(r)` with `io.ReadAll(r)` (Go 1.16+).
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoWriteString
description: Replace `fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s", s)` with `io.WriteString(w, s)`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferLenCheck
description: Normalize `len(s) >= 1` to `len(s) > 0` and `len(s) < 1` to `len(s) == 0`.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferMakeForEmptyMap
description: Replace empty map literal `map[K]V{}` with `make(map[K]V)` for clarity.
category5Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Go.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferMinMaxBuiltin
description: Replace `math.Min(a, b)` with `min(a, b)` and `math.Max(a, b)` with `max(a, b)` (Go 1.21+).

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.Android$KtRecipe
description: Search-only Android recipe family covering the deprecated-API surface (Activity / Fragment / Handler / kotlinx.android.synthetic / parcel / Vibrator / registerReceiver), storage-layer footguns (`SharedPreferences.commit`, Room `@Query` shape, `ContentResolver.query`), lifecycle smells (`LiveData.observe(this, ...)`, public `MutableLiveData`), permissions/security (`requestPermissions`, `MODE_WORLD_*`), Android-specific performance (`findViewById` in `onDraw`, raw `BitmapFactory`, `Handler.postDelayed`, `runOnUiThread`), WebView smells (`loadUrl`, `setJavaScriptEnabled`), logging smells (`Log.*`, `System.out`), and modernization candidates (manual `Parcelable`/`Serializable`, RxJava, raw Dagger, manual `ViewModelProvider`, `ObjectAnimator`, `Runtime.exec`).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAlertDialogBuilderConstructor$KtRecipe
description: `android.app.AlertDialog.Builder` does not pick up app-bar themes or Material styles. For consistent theming on AppCompat surfaces, use `androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog.Builder` (or `MaterialAlertDialogBuilder` for Material apps). Each match is worth a quick accessibility/theming review.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidLifecycleSmells$KtRecipe
description: Lifecycle and observable-state patterns that leak across configuration changes or expose internal mutability: `LiveData.observe(this, ...)` inside fragments, `MutableLiveData.postValue` from main-thread contexts, public `MutableLiveData` properties, and raw `MutableLiveData` allocations.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidLogUsage$KtRecipe
description: `android.util.Log` is a flat global logger with no routing, no structured fields, and no off-by-default for release builds. Migrate to Timber (per-tree fan-out, automatic tag detection) or AndroidX `androidx.tracing` for performance-trace integration. Each match is a candidate for the migration.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidLoggingSmells$KtRecipe
description: Logging shapes that don't compose with structured logging: `android.util.Log.v/d/i/w/e` calls (flat global logger; prefer Timber or `androidx.tracing`) and `System.out.println` on Android (untagged logcat output).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidModernizationCandidates$KtRecipe
description: Patterns that work but predate the modern Android toolchain: manual `Parcelable` (`@Parcelize`), `java.io.Serializable` on Android transports, RxJava imports (coroutines + Flow), `Dagger*Component.builder()` (Hilt), direct `ViewModelProvider` construction (`by viewModels()`), `ObjectAnimator` (Compose animation APIs), and `Runtime.exec` (audit for app-sandbox fit).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidPerformanceSmells$KtRecipe
description: Patterns that drop UI-thread frames or allocate at draw time: `findViewById` inside `onDraw`/`onMeasure`/`onLayout`, unbounded `BitmapFactory.decode*` (no `inSampleSize`), hand-rolled `Thread.start()` from UI components, `Handler.postDelayed` (no lifecycle), and pre-coroutine `runOnUiThread` / `View.post` dispatch.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidPermissionsSmells$KtRecipe
description: Permission-handling patterns the platform has deprecated: direct `requestPermissions(...)` calls and `onRequestPermissionsResult` overrides (use `ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission`), and `MODE_WORLD_READABLE` / `WORLD_WRITEABLE` (use `FileProvider`).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidStorageSmells$KtRecipe
description: Storage-tier patterns that block the main thread or sit on deprecated APIs: `SharedPreferences.Editor.commit()`, bare `prefs.edit()` calls, Room `@Query` methods returning synchronous results, `ContentResolver.query`, and Realm usage.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidViewModelInjection$KtRecipe
description: `ViewModelProvider(this).get(MyViewModel::class.java)` predates the `by viewModels()` / `by activityViewModels()` Kotlin property delegates. With Hilt, those delegates pick up the `@HiltViewModel` annotation — no factory plumbing needed at the call site.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAndroidWebViewSmells$KtRecipe
description: WebView call sites that need a security review: `WebView.loadUrl(...)` (URL trust boundary) and `WebSettings.setJavaScriptEnabled(true)` (script-execution trust boundary). For untrusted content, Chrome Custom Tabs (`CustomTabsIntent`) is the safer alternative.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAsyncTask$KtRecipe
description: `AsyncTask` was deprecated in API 30. The Kotlin replacement is `viewModelScope.launch { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { … } }` or another coroutine-aware framework. Each match is a candidate for migration.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindAsyncTaskExecute$KtRecipe
description: Beyond `AsyncTask` instantiation, the `execute`/`executeOnExecutor` call sites are the place the background work actually starts. Migration to `viewModelScope.launch { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { … } }` happens at the call site, not the declaration — flag both.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindBareHandlerConstructor$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `Handler()` constructor calls without an explicit `Looper`
description: The zero-arg `Handler` constructor was deprecated in API 30 because it implicitly captures the current thread's looper — a footgun when called from a background thread. Always pass an explicit `Looper`, e.g. `Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindBitmapFactoryDecode$KtRecipe
description: `BitmapFactory.decode*` without an explicit `BitmapFactory.Options.inSampleSize` allocates the bitmap at full source resolution. For UI use, downsample via `inSampleSize` (or move the entire concern to Coil/Glide, which handle pooling, lifecycle, and downsampling for you).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindContentResolverQuery$KtRecipe
description: `ContentResolver.query(...)` blocks the calling thread for the full lifetime of the underlying IPC and cursor walk. Wrap the call in `withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { … }`, expose it as a `Flow` (`contentResolver.observe(uri)`-style), or move to a Room `@Query` if the data is backed by SQLite.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindContextRegisterReceiver$KtRecipe
description: On API 33+ `registerReceiver(...)` requires an explicit `RECEIVER_EXPORTED` / `RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED` flag — calls without it throw `SecurityException`. Migrate to `ContextCompat.registerReceiver(...)`, which forwards the flag and is backwards-compatible.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindDeprecatedAndroidApis$KtRecipe
description: Search-only bundle that flags Android APIs the platform has deprecated or removed: `findViewById`, `AsyncTask`, the single-arg `getColor`/`getDrawable`/`getColorStateList` resource getters, the zero-arg `Handler()` constructor, `kotlinx.android.synthetic` imports, the moved `kotlinx.android.parcel.Parcelize` import, `startActivityForResult`/`onActivityResult`/`requestPermissions`, `LocalBroadcastManager`, deprecated `Fragment` lifecycle methods, `Resources.getDrawable` / `getColor`, `startService`, `PreferenceManager`, `Vibrator.vibrate(long)`, `Context.registerReceiver` without flags, and `MutableLiveData` allocations.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindDeprecatedParcelizeImport$KtRecipe
description: The `kotlinx.android.parcel` package was moved to `kotlinx.parcelize` in 2020 when the standalone Parcelize plugin shipped. Replace the import and the Gradle plugin coordinate.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindDeprecatedResourceGetters$KtRecipe
description: The single-argument forms on `Context`/`Resources` are deprecated — they don't take a theme and behave inconsistently across API levels. Use `ContextCompat.getColor(context, id)`/`ContextCompat.getDrawable(context, id)`/`AppCompatResources.getColorStateList(context, id)` instead.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindFindViewById$KtRecipe
description: `findViewById` is the legacy view-lookup API. Modern Android uses ViewBinding (auto-generated `Binding` classes per layout) which is type-safe, null-safe, and avoids the per-call HashMap walk. Each match is a candidate for migration.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindFindViewByIdInHotPath$KtRecipe
description: View tree-walking inside the draw/measure/layout pass costs frame budget on every pass. Cache the lookup once (in `onFinishInflate` or a `lateinit` initialized when the view attaches), or — better — migrate to ViewBinding so the cache is generated.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindFragmentManagerExecutePendingTransactions$KtRecipe
description: `executePendingTransactions()` forces synchronous fragment-transaction execution on the calling thread — usually a workaround for code that races a not-yet-attached fragment. Prefer `commitNow()`/`commitNowAllowingStateLoss()` at the call site that scheduled the transaction, or restructure the call to read state from the resulting fragment's `onViewCreated`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindFragmentOnActivityCreated$KtRecipe
description: `Fragment.onActivityCreated(Bundle)` was deprecated in Fragment 1.3 because the host-activity lifecycle is no longer a reliable signal for fragment readiness. Move the work to `onViewCreated` (view-state setup) or to a `LifecycleObserver` on `viewLifecycleOwner` (cross-component coordination).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindFragmentOnAttachActivity$KtRecipe
description: The `onAttach(Activity)` overload was deprecated in API 23 — use `onAttach(Context)` instead. The `Context` parameter is the activity for activity-hosted fragments and the application context for headless cases, and works on devices where the parent is not an activity.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindFragmentSetRetainInstance$KtRecipe
description: `Fragment.setRetainInstance(true)` was deprecated in Fragment 1.3 because retained fragments break process-death restoration and tangle the lifecycle owner with the host activity. Move retained state to a `ViewModel` scoped to the navigation host.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindHandlerPostDelayed$KtRecipe
description: `Handler.postDelayed(runnable, ms)` schedules main-thread work without a story for cancellation — the canonical bug is the activity dying while the runnable is still scheduled, then running with a stale view reference. Use `lifecycleScope.launch { delay(ms); … }` instead: cancellation is automatic on lifecycle teardown.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindIntentActionGetContent$KtRecipe
description: `ACTION_PICK` / `ACTION_GET_CONTENT` predate the Photo Picker (`ACTION_PICK_IMAGES`, API 33+ with backport) and the Storage Access Framework (`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT`). For media, prefer `ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia`; for documents, `OpenDocument`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindKotlinAndroidSyntheticImports$KtRecipe
description: The Kotlin Android Extensions synthetic-view plugin was deprecated in 1.4.20 and removed entirely in later AGP versions. Migrate the call sites to ViewBinding. Each reference here corresponds to a usage that won't compile without the (removed) plugin.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindLifecycleObserveLiveData$KtRecipe
description: Inside a `Fragment`, `liveData.observe(this, observer)` ties the subscription to the fragment's lifecycle — which outlives the view across `onDestroyView`/`onCreateView` recreation and produces dangling references to a destroyed view. Use `viewLifecycleOwner` instead.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindLiveDataPostValueFromMain$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `MutableLiveData.postValue(...)` calls inside coroutine main-thread contexts
description: `postValue` exists for background-thread updaters — it marshals through the main looper and coalesces consecutive updates. When called from a place that already runs on the main thread (UI callbacks, view-model initialization, `Dispatchers.Main` blocks), the coalescing is a footgun: intermediate values silently drop. Use `setValue`/`.value =` on the main thread, `postValue` only from background threads.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindLocalBroadcastManager$KtRecipe
description: `LocalBroadcastManager` was deprecated in AndroidX 1.1 — the project effectively documents it as a global event bus, with all the ordering and lifetime trouble that implies. Migrate to `LiveData`, `StateFlow`, or `SharedFlow` for in-process pub/sub.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindManualDaggerProvision$KtRecipe
description: Calls of the form `DaggerXComponent.builder().build()` indicate the application is composing its dependency graph by hand. Hilt (`@HiltAndroidApp` / `@AndroidEntryPoint`) generates the same graph automatically and integrates with Compose, ViewModel, and WorkManager out of the box.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindManualThreadingInActivity$KtRecipe
description: Hand-rolled `Thread { … }.start()` inside a UI component leaks across configuration changes (the thread outlives the activity) and has no story for cancellation. Migrate to `lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) { … }` or `viewModelScope.launch { … }` — both cancel when the lifecycle ends.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindModeWorldReadable$KtRecipe
description: Both constants were deprecated in API 17 — they grant any app on the device read or write access to the file. Use a `FileProvider` to share content URIs, or scope the file via `Context.getFilesDir()` and expose it through your own content provider with explicit permissions.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindMutableLiveDataAllocation$KtRecipe
description: In Kotlin Android code, `MutableStateFlow<T>` is the modern equivalent. It integrates with structured concurrency, exposes the current value synchronously, and composes cleanly with Compose's `collectAsState`/`collectAsStateWithLifecycle`. Each `MutableLiveData()` here is a candidate for migration.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindObjectAnimator$KtRecipe
description: Direct `ObjectAnimator` use is a candidate for review — for Compose UIs the idiomatic replacement is `animate*AsState` / `Animatable`, which integrate with recomposition and cancellation. For view-system code, `SpringAnimation`/`PhysicsAnimation` cover more interaction shapes than the time-based `ObjectAnimator`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindOnActivityResultOverride$KtRecipe
description: Every override of `Activity.onActivityResult` / `Fragment.onActivityResult` is half of the deprecated `startActivityForResult` pair. The new Activity Result APIs (`registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.X) { … }`) deliver results to a lambda colocated with the launcher — the override goes away.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindOnRequestPermissionsResultOverride$KtRecipe
description: Override of `Activity.onRequestPermissionsResult` / `Fragment.onRequestPermissionsResult` — the result-callback half of the deprecated `requestPermissions(...)` pair. Replace with a `registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission)` lambda.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindParcelableJavaImpl$KtRecipe
description: Manual `writeToParcel` / `CREATOR` implementations are pure boilerplate that the `kotlin-parcelize` plugin generates for any class annotated `@Parcelize`. Each manual implementation is a candidate for migration to the annotation.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindPreferenceManagerGetDefaultSharedPreferences$KtRecipe
description: `android.preference.*` (framework) was deprecated in API 29. AndroidX `androidx.preference.*` is the supported path, and even there the modern shape for KV state is Jetpack DataStore (`Preferences DataStore` for key/value, `Proto DataStore` for typed records) — which works in `suspend` contexts and survives process death without main-thread blocking.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindPreferenceManagerImport$KtRecipe
description: The framework `android.preference.*` package was deprecated in API 29. Move to `androidx.preference.*` (drop-in replacement) or, for KV state, Jetpack DataStore — which composes with coroutines and `Flow` instead of running on the main thread.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindPublicMutableLiveDataProperty$KtRecipe
description: Exposing `MutableLiveData<T>` (or `MutableStateFlow<T>`) to observers lets them mutate the model from the consumer side. The convention is to keep the mutable handle `private` and expose a read-only `LiveData<T>` / `StateFlow<T>` getter, so the owner is the only one that can publish updates.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindRealmUsage$KtRecipe
description: Realm Java/Kotlin is in maintenance and was effectively superseded by Realm Kotlin (`io.realm.kotlin`) and ultimately by MongoDB Atlas Device SDKs. Each `Realm.getDefaultInstance()` is a candidate for migration to Room + DataStore, or to the modern Realm Kotlin SDK.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindRequestPermissions$KtRecipe
description: Calling `requestPermissions(...)` directly couples the request to a screen and a request code that has to be matched in `onRequestPermissionsResult`. The modern shape is `registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()) { granted -> … }` — the result lands in a lambda next to the launcher.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindResourcesGetColor$KtRecipe
description: `Resources.getColor(int)` was deprecated in API 23 — it doesn't take a theme. Replace with `ContextCompat.getColor(context, id)`, which threads the theme through and respects `?attr` references.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindResourcesGetDrawable$KtRecipe
description: `Resources.getDrawable(int)` was deprecated in API 22 — it doesn't take a theme. Replace with `ResourcesCompat.getDrawable(resources, id, theme)` to render themed drawables consistently across API levels.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindRoomQueryWithoutLiveDataOrFlow$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `@Query` DAO methods returning a synchronous result
description: A non-suspend `@Query` returning `List<X>`, `X?`, or a scalar runs the DB query on the calling thread — by default Room throws `IllegalStateException` if that's the main thread. Mark the function `suspend` (single-shot) or return `Flow<...>` / `LiveData<...>` (observable) so Room can dispatch the query off the main thread.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindRunOnUiThread$KtRecipe
description: Hand-rolled main-thread dispatch (`runOnUiThread`, `view.post`) was the pre-coroutine pattern for crossing thread boundaries from a background worker. In Kotlin, prefer `withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { … }` — it composes with structured cancellation and surfaces in the call site's coroutine context.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindRuntimeExecInAndroid$KtRecipe
description: Forking a process from an Android app is almost never the right shape — the system imposes strict app-sandbox limits (no `su`, no arbitrary binaries) and process lifetime is unrelated to the activity that spawned it. Audit each call site against `WorkManager`, foreground services, or — if you genuinely need shell tools — `java.lang.ProcessBuilder` with explicit lifecycle management.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindRxJavaImports$KtRecipe
description: RxJava is in maintenance and Kotlin's idiomatic story is coroutines + `Flow`. Each import is a candidate for migration to `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.*` (or, at the boundary, `kotlinx-coroutines-rx3`/`kotlinx-coroutines-rx2` adapters during incremental migration).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindSerializableUsage$KtRecipe
description: `java.io.Serializable` is reflection-based and slow on Android — it allocates substantially more than `Parcelable` and pulls in field-by-field reflection at deserialize time. For inter-component transport, prefer `@Parcelize` (`kotlin-parcelize`) or `kotlinx.serialization`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindSharedPreferencesCommit$KtRecipe
description: `commit()` writes to disk on the calling thread (often the main thread, where it can drop a frame). `apply()` writes asynchronously and atomically, returning immediately — use it unless you specifically need the boolean result on the spot.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindSharedPreferencesEdit$KtRecipe
description: Raw `edit()` calls predate AndroidX `SharedPreferences.edit { … }`, the Kotlin extension that handles `apply`/`commit` for the caller. Replace each `prefs.edit().put*(...).apply()` chain with `prefs.edit { put*(...) }` — same disk write, less ceremony, and harder to drop the apply by accident.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindStartActivityForResult$KtRecipe
description: `startActivityForResult` was deprecated in AndroidX Activity 1.2 / Fragment 1.3 in favor of the Activity Result APIs (`registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.X) { result -> … }`). The new API survives process death, decouples the launcher from the lifecycle owner, and removes the per-screen `onActivityResult` switch.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindStartService$KtRecipe
description: On API 26+ background apps cannot call `startService(...)` — the system throws `IllegalStateException`. For services that must run while the app is backgrounded, call `ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, intent)` and post a notification within five seconds. For one-shot work, use `WorkManager` instead.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindSystemOutInAndroid$KtRecipe
description: `System.out` on Android writes to logcat under a default tag that's easy to lose. Use `Log.d`/`Log.i` for tagged output (or, better, Timber) — both route through Android's logging pipeline with filterable tags.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindVibratorVibrateLong$KtRecipe
description: The single-`long` `Vibrator.vibrate(ms)` was deprecated in API 26. Use `Vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(...))` (or `VibratorManager` on API 31+) — both let the platform pick the appropriate amplitude.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindWebViewJavaScriptEnabled$KtRecipe
description: Enabling JavaScript in a WebView lets the loaded page run arbitrary script in your app's context. For first-party content this is often fine; for any third-party content it's a critical security boundary. Each match is worth reviewing alongside the trust model of the loaded URLs.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.android.FindWebViewLoadUrl$KtRecipe
description: Each `WebView.loadUrl(...)` is worth a security review: arbitrary http://-scheme URLs bypass the system browser and inherit the WebView's privileges (cookies, JS bridges). For untrusted content prefer `CustomTabsIntent` (Chrome Custom Tabs) — better security, better UX, no JS bridge.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.BestPractices$KtRecipe
description: Opinionated bundle of every best-practice recipe in this module: collection / string round-trip collapses, stdlib accessor swaps, and a broad set of search-only flags covering class structure, function declarations, string construction, Boolean conditionals, lambdas, and exception handling. For diff-only output, use `ImproveKotlinBestPractices` instead.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.CollapseRedundantConversions$KtRecipe
description: Drops needless `toList()`/`toMutableList()`/`toSet()`/`toTypedArray()` round-trips and `trimStart().trimEnd()`-style chains that allocate one or more intermediate copies. The replacement performs the same conversion in one pass.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindAbstractClassWithoutMembers$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `abstract class` declarations without abstract members
description: An `abstract class` with no abstract members and no state offers nothing over `interface` — and `interface` composes better (multiple inheritance, no constructor coupling). If the class is being used as a marker, consider `sealed interface` for stronger exhaustiveness checks.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindAlsoPrintln$KtRecipe
description: `.also { println(it) }` is a side-channel print left over from debugging. It survives compilation, runs in production, and is invisible at the call site — remove it or route the value through a logger.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindAlsoWithEmptyBody$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `x.also { }` calls with an empty body
description: `x.also { }` with an empty block is a no-op that returns `x`. Drop the call — it adds an allocation for the captured lambda and obscures the value flow.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindAnonymousObjectSingleMethod$KtRecipe
displayName: Find anonymous `object : Interface { override fun … }` with a single override
description: An anonymous object that implements one interface with a single function override is the canonical SAM-conversion target. If the interface is declared `fun interface I { … }`, the call site collapses to a lambda.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindBareExceptionThrow$KtRecipe
description: Throwing bare `Exception` (or `RuntimeException`) loses information that a more specific type would carry. Prefer `IllegalArgumentException` (bad input), `IllegalStateException` (object in wrong state), or a domain-specific subclass.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindBareRuntimeExceptionThrow$KtRecipe
description: Same family as `throw Exception("...")` — flag for replacement with `IllegalArgumentException`/`IllegalStateException`/domain-specific subclass.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindBestPracticeCandidates$KtRecipe
description: Search-only bundle: flags places where a more idiomatic Kotlin spelling is available. Each match shows up as a `SearchResult` for review; nothing is rewritten automatically because the migration is a judgment call.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindBooleanConditionalSmells$KtRecipe
description: `if (x) true else false`, its inverse, `!x.isEmpty()` / `!x.isBlank()` family negations, `if (x == null) null else x.foo()`, `if (x != null) x.foo()` patterns, and `if (return …) else …` early-return ladders — each is the long form of a single Kotlin operator or method.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindBooleanLiteralReturnType$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `fun f(): Boolean = true|false` literal-returning functions
description: A function whose body is literally `true` or `false` is rarely the right shape — either the predicate was a stub left in by mistake, or the value is genuinely constant and should be a `const val`. Either way, surface the call site for human review.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindCatchReturningNull$KtRecipe
description: Swallowing every exception into `null` discards diagnostic information and conflates 'no value' with 'I lost the cause'. `runCatching { }` returns a `Result<T>` whose `getOrNull()` matches this shape, and `onFailure { }` keeps a hook for diagnostics.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindClassExtendsAny$KtRecipe
description: Every class implicitly extends `Any` — writing it explicitly only adds noise and a redundant supertype clause.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindClassStructureSmells$KtRecipe
description: Search-only bundle: flags class-level structural smells (empty companion, empty class body, redundant `: Any()`, manual `toString`/`equals`/`hashCode` trio, named companion of constants, multiple secondary constructors, sealed-class-without-state, marker-object-without-data, empty init, all-val classes that could be `data class`, mutable `data class`/object state, abstract classes without abstract members, and `open` classes with no overridable members).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindClassWithoutDataAnnotation$KtRecipe
displayName: Find classes that could be `data class`
description: A class whose only members are `val` constructor parameters — no methods, no init, no extra properties — is the canonical shape `data class` exists for. Adding `data` synthesizes `toString`/`equals`/`hashCode`/`copy`/`componentN` without changing any other semantics.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindCompareToInsteadOfOperator$KtRecipe
description: `x.compareTo(y) > 0` is the long form of `x > y` for any `Comparable<T>` — and `>`/`<`/`>=`/`<=` are defined on `Comparable` to use exactly that call. The operator form reads as the comparison it is, and the bytecode emitted is identical.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindDataClassWithMutableProperty$KtRecipe
description: `data class` generates `equals` and `hashCode` over the primary-constructor properties. Mutating a `var` property after the instance is stored in a hash-based collection breaks the invariant — the entry can no longer be found by lookup. Prefer `val`; if mutation is needed, model it through `copy(...)`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindDataObjectCandidates$KtRecipe
displayName: Find marker `object` declarations that could be `data object`
description: A bare `object Foo` declaration with no body inherits `Any.toString()`, which prints as `Foo$Companion@<hash>`-style identity strings. `data object Foo` (Kotlin 1.9+) generates a readable `toString` (`"Foo"`), `equals` (identity), and `hashCode` — preferred for marker singletons used in `when` exhaustiveness checks and serialization.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindDoubleBangChain$KtRecipe
displayName: Find chained `!!` assertions in a single expression
description: `x!!.y!!.z` chains multiple `!!` assertions in one expression. Each one is a separate NPE risk with no diagnostic. Either the intermediate values are non-null (and the assertions can be dropped) or the chain should be modeled with `?.let { }` to surface the absent case explicitly.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindElseAfterReturn$KtRecipe
description: When the `if` branch returns, the `else` is unreachable as a fall-through guard — the body after the `else` can be moved out of the `else` block, which makes the early-return shape obvious to readers.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindEmptyClassBody$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `class Foo {}` declarations with an empty body
description: An empty class body `{}` adds no information. Kotlin allows the body to be omitted entirely: `class Foo` is the same declaration without the redundant braces.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindEmptyCompanionObject$KtRecipe
description: A `companion object {}` with no members generates a synthetic `Companion` holder class that's never used. Remove it — Kotlin doesn't require an empty companion object for any feature.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindEmptyInitBlock$KtRecipe
description: An empty `init {}` block is a no-op. Remove it — every empty initializer is a place a future reader pauses before noticing it does nothing.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindEqualitySmells$KtRecipe
description: `===` / `!==` referential checks (usually `==` is meant), `x == true|false` longhand for Boolean, and `x.compareTo(y) > 0` calls that should use the comparison operator directly.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindEqualsToBooleanLiteral$KtRecipe
description: When `b` is `Boolean`, `b == true` is just `b` and `b == false` is `!b`. The longhand only obscures intent. For `Boolean?` the longhand is meaningful — it returns `false` for `null` rather than failing on `!!` — so leave those alone; flag only the comparison and let the reviewer decide.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindExceptionHandlingSmells$KtRecipe
description: `Throwable.printStackTrace()` (bypasses the logger), bare `throw Exception("…")` / `throw RuntimeException("…")` allocations (lose type information), and `try { } catch (e: Exception) { null }` patterns (collapsible to `runCatching { }.getOrNull()`).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindExplicitUnitReturnType$KtRecipe
displayName: Find functions with explicit `: Unit` return type
description: Kotlin functions that don't declare a return type return `Unit` by convention. Writing `: Unit` explicitly adds noise — drop it unless the explicit form aids a generated API surface (e.g. `@JvmOverloads`).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindForEachAddCandidate$KtRecipe
description: `xs.forEach { ys.add(it) }` is the loop-form of `ys.addAll(xs)`. The bulk operation is a single method call and uses the most efficient copy strategy the receiver supports.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindForEachPrintln$KtRecipe
description: `forEach { println(it) }` is the loop-form `for (x in xs) println(x)` — verify whether the print is debug-only. If it is intended output, consider `joinToString("\n").let(::println)` to write the whole thing in one syscall.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindForceUnwrapInLet$KtRecipe
description: `x?.let { it!! }` (or `it.foo()!!`) is internally inconsistent: the safe-call entry already guards null, so the `!!` on `it` can never trigger. Drop the `!!` — the lambda body has a non-null receiver by construction.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindFunctionDeclarationSmells$KtRecipe
description: Search-only bundle: explicit `: Unit` / `: Nothing` return type, block bodies that are a single `return expr`, literal-Boolean-returning functions, `Pair`/`Triple` returns that could be data classes, default-before-required parameters, `suspend fun` declarations returning `Job`/`Deferred`, and explicit `return Unit` statements.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindFunctionReturningPair$KtRecipe
description: A function returning `Pair<A, B>` forces every caller to remember which side is which. A small `data class Result(val a: A, val b: B)` documents the role of each component and gains `componentN()` / `copy()` for free.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindFunctionReturningTriple$KtRecipe
description: Same shape as the `Pair` case but the readability cost compounds — three positional components is the limit where most readers stop guessing which is which. Replace with a `data class`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindIfNullElseExpression$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `if (x == null) null else x.foo()` patterns
description: An `if (x == null) null else x.foo()` collapses to the safe-call `x?.foo()`. The safe-call is structurally null-aware — the longhand re-checks for null without surfacing the absent case in the type system.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindIfReturnFalseElseTrue$KtRecipe
description: `if (x) false else true` is just `!x`. Replace the inverted Boolean conditional with the negation it already expresses.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindIfReturnTrueElseFalse$KtRecipe
description: `if (x) true else false` is just `x` after Boolean simplification. The longhand only hides intent.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindIsNotEmptyOnString$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `x.isNotEmpty()` on `String` where `isNotBlank()` might be wanted
description: `String.isNotEmpty()` returns true for whitespace-only strings. When the check exists to guard against missing user input, `isNotBlank()` is usually closer to the intent.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindLambdaSmells$KtRecipe
description: Redundant `map { it.toString() }` / `forEach { it.toString() }`, debug-leftover `.also { println(it) }` / `forEach { println(it) }`, `xs.toList().forEach { }` over already-iterable receivers, `.also { it.add(...) }`-built mutable collections, and `forEach { ys.add(it) }` (use `addAll`).
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindLazyWithoutMode$KtRecipe
description: `lazy { }` defaults to `LazyThreadSafetyMode.SYNCHRONIZED` — every read passes a synchronized check. For thread-confined state (UI, single-threaded actors), `lazy(LazyThreadSafetyMode.NONE) { }` avoids the synchronization entirely.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindLetForNotNullCheck$KtRecipe
description: `if (x != null) { x.foo() }` is the long form of `x?.let { it.foo() }` — or, when only one call is needed and `x` is a local, `x?.foo()`. The safe-call form makes the null-aware path part of the type system rather than a separate Boolean check.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindManualToStringEqualsHashCode$KtRecipe
description: A class that overrides all three of `toString`, `equals`, and `hashCode` over its own fields is the canonical shape `data class` exists for. Migrate to `data class C(val a: A, …)` to delete the boilerplate and gain `copy()` plus `componentN()` for free.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindMultipleSecondaryConstructors$KtRecipe
displayName: Find classes with multiple overloaded secondary constructors
description: Two or more secondary constructors with different arities almost always collapse into a single primary constructor with default arguments. The default-arg form composes with named arguments and `@JvmOverloads` for cross-language interop.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindMutableListAlsoAdd$KtRecipe
description: Building a list through `mutableListOf<T>().also { it.add(...) }` is the side-channel form of `buildList { add(...) }` (or just `mutableListOf(x)` if every element is known up front). The builder form makes intent explicit.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindMutableMapAlsoPut$KtRecipe
description: Same shape as `mutableListOf().also { it.add(...) }` for maps. The builder form (`buildMap { put(...) }`) makes the entries visible without the side-channel `it.put`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindMutableSetAlsoAdd$KtRecipe
description: Same shape as the `mutableListOf` variant — use `buildSet { add(...) }` for the same readability gain.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindNamedCompanionObjectOfConstants$KtRecipe
description: A `companion object Constants { const val X = ... }` adds a named singleton to hold what are essentially file-level constants. Promote the constants to top-level `const val`s — they read the same and avoid the synthetic holder class.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindNegatedIsBlank$KtRecipe
description: Kotlin's `String.isNotBlank()` is the direct positive form. The negated-blank check reads the same value without the leading `!`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindNegatedIsEmpty$KtRecipe
description: Kotlin ships `isNotEmpty()` directly on `String`, `Collection`, and `Map`. The negation reads top-down without re-parsing the `!`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindNegatedIsNotBlank$KtRecipe
description: `!x.isNotBlank()` is the long form of `x.isBlank()`.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindNegatedIsNotEmpty$KtRecipe
description: `!x.isNotEmpty()` is the long form of `x.isEmpty()`. Use the direct positive call.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindObjectWithMutableState$KtRecipe
description: An `object` is a singleton — its `var` properties are shared global mutable state. Concurrent reads/writes race without synchronization, and the value can change in surprising ways across modules.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindOpenClassWithoutOverrides$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `open class` declarations without overridable members
description: The `open` modifier on a class only matters if subclasses override something. A bare `open class Foo` (or one whose members are all `final`) signals an intent — "this class is meant to be extended" — that the type system can't actually enforce. Either declare specific members `open` (and drop the class-level `open`) or remove the modifier entirely.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindRedundantReturnUnit$KtRecipe
description: Functions that return `Unit` don't need an explicit return at all — `return` (no expression) or simply falling off the end is the conventional shape. Writing `return Unit` repeats the implicit value.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindRedundantToStringInForEach$KtRecipe
description: `it.toString()` inside a `forEach` evaluates the call but discards the result — equivalent to `forEach {}`. Either the side effect on `toString()` is the goal (very unusual) or the call is dead code.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindRedundantToStringInMap$KtRecipe
description: If the producer already returns a type whose `toString()` is the desired representation, the `map` is a no-op. If the goal is to materialize the `String`s up-front, `joinToString()` / `toString()` on the collection is usually a better fit.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindReferentialEquality$KtRecipe
description: Kotlin's `===` checks reference identity, ignoring `equals`. For `data class` and other value-like types this almost always wants `==` instead. Flag every referential check for review — true reference comparisons (e.g. sentinel `Any` objects) are legitimate but rare.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindReturnTypeNothing$KtRecipe
displayName: Find functions declared with `: Nothing` return type
description: `Nothing` means 'this function never returns normally' — the body must `throw`, loop forever, or call another `Nothing`-returning function. Flag for review: if the body actually does return, the type is wrong; if it always throws, the call sites can rely on Kotlin's exhaustiveness checks.
category6Description: Recipes to search and transform Kotlin.

name: org.openrewrite.kotlin.bestpractices.FindRunWithEmptyBody$KtRecipe
displayName: Find `run { }` calls with an empty body
