displayName: Target of [XamlSetMarkupExtension] should exist and have correct signature
description: `[XamlSetMarkupExtension]` names its handler as a string, so a missing method or a wrong signature is only discovered when XAML is loaded. Flags the attribute when no `void Handler(object, XamlSetMarkupExtensionEventArgs)` is reachable on the type.
category4Description: Correctness rules for WPF dependency properties, routed events, and value converters
category5Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality
category6Description: Recipes for C# codebases.

displayName: Target of [XamlSetTypeConverter] should exist and have correct signature
description: `[XamlSetTypeConverter]` names its handler as a string, so a missing method or a wrong signature is only discovered when XAML is loaded. Flags the attribute when no `void Handler(object, XamlSetTypeConverterEventArgs)` is reachable on the type.
category4Description: Correctness rules for WPF dependency properties, routed events, and value converters
category5Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality
category6Description: Recipes for C# codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.AllBranchesIdentical
description: Replace `if`/`elif`/`else` chains where every branch has the same body with just the body, since the condition has no effect on what code executes.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.BooleanChecksNotInverted
displayName: Boolean checks should not be inverted
description: Replace inverted boolean comparisons like `not (a == b)` with the equivalent direct operator (`a != b`), and remove double negations like `not (not x)`.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.CollapsibleIfStatements
description: Combine nested `if` statements that have no `else` branch into a single `if` joined with `and`.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.MergeIdenticalBranches
displayName: Merge consecutive branches with identical bodies
description: Combine consecutive `if`/`elif` branches that have the same body into a single branch with conditions joined by `or`.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.RemoveDuplicateConditions
displayName: Remove duplicate conditions in if/elif chains
description: Remove `elif` branches whose condition is identical to an earlier branch in the same `if`/`elif` chain, since the duplicate branch is dead code that can never execute.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.RemoveSelfAssignment
description: Remove statements that assign a variable to itself (`x = x`, `self.x = self.x`), since they have no effect.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.RemoveUnconditionalValueOverwrite
description: Remove consecutive assignments that write to the same dict key or object attribute, since the first value is immediately overwritten and never used.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.SimplifyBooleanLiteral
description: Replace comparisons against boolean literals (`== True`, `!= False`, `is True`, etc.) with the simpler equivalent boolean expression.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.codequality.SimplifyRedundantLogicalExpression
description: Replace `x and x` with `x` and `x or x` with `x`. Identical operands in a logical expression are redundant and often indicate a copy-paste mistake.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindAifcModule
description: The `aifc` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use third-party audio libraries instead.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindAsyncioCoroutineDecorator
description: Find usage of the deprecated `@asyncio.coroutine` decorator which was removed in Python 3.11. Convert to `async def` syntax with `await` instead of `yield from`.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindAudioopModule
description: The `audioop` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use pydub, numpy, or scipy for audio operations.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindCgiModule
description: The `cgi` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `urllib.parse` for query string parsing, `html.escape()` for escaping, and web frameworks or `email.message` for form handling.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindCgitbModule
description: The `cgitb` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use the standard `logging` and `traceback` modules for error handling.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindChunkModule
description: The `chunk` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Implement IFF chunk reading manually or use specialized libraries.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindCryptModule
description: The `crypt` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `bcrypt`, `argon2-cffi`, or `passlib` instead.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindDistutilsUsage
description: Find imports of the deprecated `distutils` module which was removed in Python 3.12. Migrate to `setuptools` or other modern build tools.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindFunctoolsCmpToKey
description: Find usage of `functools.cmp_to_key()` which is a Python 2 compatibility function. Consider using a key function directly.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindImghdrModule
description: The `imghdr` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `filetype`, `python-magic`, or `Pillow` instead.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindImpUsage
description: Find imports of the deprecated `imp` module which was removed in Python 3.12. Migrate to `importlib`.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindLocaleGetdefaultlocale
description: `locale.getdefaultlocale()` was deprecated in Python 3.11. Use `locale.setlocale()`, `locale.getlocale()`, or `locale.getpreferredencoding(False)` instead.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindMacpathModule
description: The `macpath` module was removed in Python 3.8. Use `os.path` instead.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindMailcapModule
description: The `mailcap` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `mimetypes` module for MIME type handling.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindMsilibModule
description: The `msilib` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use platform-specific tools for MSI creation.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindNisModule
description: The `nis` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. There is no direct replacement.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindNntplibModule
description: The `nntplib` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. NNTP is largely obsolete; consider alternatives if needed.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindOsPopen
description: `os.popen()` has been deprecated since Python 3.6. Use `subprocess.run()` or `subprocess.Popen()` instead for better control over process creation and output handling.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindOsSpawn
description: The `os.spawn*()` family of functions are deprecated. Use `subprocess.run()` or `subprocess.Popen()` instead.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindOssaudiodevModule
description: The `ossaudiodev` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. There is no direct replacement.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindPathlibLinkTo
description: Find usage of `Path.link_to()` which was deprecated in Python 3.10 and removed in 3.12. Use `hardlink_to()` instead (note: argument order is reversed).
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindPipesModule
description: The `pipes` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use subprocess with shlex.quote() for shell escaping.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindRemovedModules312

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSndhdrModule

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSocketGetFQDN

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSpwdModule

category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSslMatchHostname

category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindTelnetlibModule

category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindTempfileMktemp

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindUrllibParseSplitFunctions

category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindXdrlibModule
description: The `xdrlib` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `struct` module for binary packing/unpacking.
category6Description: Recipes for Python codebases.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.MigrateAsyncioCoroutine
description: Migrate functions using the deprecated `@asyncio.coroutine` decorator to use `async def` syntax. Also transforms `yield from` to `await`. The decorator was removed in Python 3.11.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstNum

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstStr

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceDatetimeUtcFromTimestamp

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceElementGetchildren

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceEventIsSet

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceGettextDeprecations

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceHtmlParserUnescape

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTarfileFilemode

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadGetName

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadIsAlive

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadIsDaemon

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadSetDaemon

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadSetName

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadingActiveCount
